$comment: Actor-free Earth Shield idle loop. Frames sample a 144-frame, 24 fps Blender cycle every other frame for a 72-frame, 12 fps game sheet.
name: Earth Shield - Idle
description: A transparent mineral dome grows from the ground, holds, retracts, and rests while textured guardian stones orbit continuously around it.
author: vfx-pipeline

sprite.$comment: Render at 512px, then pack_sheets downsamples to the 128px gameplay cell.

anchor.$comment: Centered on the protected actor's origin; the actor is omitted from the sprites.

layers.note: One transparent composite layer: the rising mineral dome, its warm reveal glow, and three compact textured orbiting stones with two small trailing chips each. No actor or guide geometry.
